requirements.text: Offices are fully cleaned three times a week; washrooms and touch points (handles, switches, rails) are cleaned daily, Monday to Friday.
Work takes place between 6:00 and 8:30 or after 18:00; no work while the public is present, except washrooms.
“Les Hirondelles” nursery: specific protocol, fragrance- and allergen-free products, weekly toy disinfection.
Accessible inside and outside windows twice a year; work at height with suitable means (pole, lift).
The contractor takes over the staff assigned to the contract under the cleaning-sector collective agreement; named list of 14 staff in appendix 5.
A lead supervisor is reachable from 6:00 to 19:00; an area manager makes a monthly inspection visit.
Any absent cleaner is replaced from the first day of absence.
Quarterly joint inspections on a shared grid; deviations fixed within 24 working hours.
Eco-labelled products (EU Ecolabel or equivalent) for at least 80% of uses; safety data sheets provided.
Waste sorted according to each site's rules; bins emptied daily.
Social clause: at least 5% of hours performed by people on an inclusion pathway.
The DQE is completed without changing quantities; annual hours stated in the proposal must match those in the DQE.
The site visit is mandatory; the visit certificate is attached to the bid, otherwise the bid is non-compliant.

chunks.title: Past proposal — Brume-sur-Lys town hall, office buildings (2025)
chunks.text: Set-up for Brume-sur-Lys town hall (fictional): work from 6:00 to 8:30 and after 18:00, never with the public present. Offices three times a week, washrooms and touch points daily. 9 cleaners, 4,100 hours a year, supervisor on site in the morning.

chunks.title: Protocol — Early-childhood settings
chunks.text: Fragrance- and allergen-free products approved with the nursery management. Weekly steam disinfection of toys and mats, no chemicals. Staff trained on the early-childhood protocol before assignment. Cleaning after the children leave.

chunks.title: Method statement — Windows and work at height
chunks.text: Pure-water pole up to 12 m from the ground. Above that, a lift operated by our usual subcontractor, declared on a DC4. Area cordoned off and prevention plan agreed with the buyer before each job.

chunks.title: Procedure — Staff transfer (cleaning collective agreement)
chunks.text: Transfer timeline from D-30 to D0: staff briefing, one-to-one interview, contract amendment, seniority and pay kept as the sector agreement requires. An HR contact follows each file until the first payslip.

chunks.title: CV — Nadia Ferreira, lead supervisor
chunks.text: Nadia Ferreira (fictional person): 12 years in cleaning, 7 as team lead on public sites. Manages up to 15 cleaners. Reachable 6:00–19:00. Trained in early-childhood protocols and quality control.

chunks.title: Organisation — Cover pool
chunks.text: Pool of 6 relief cleaners in the Val-Brumeux area. Cover from the first day of absence; replacement on site on average 2 h after the alert in 2025 (fictional internal figure).

chunks.title: Quality-control plan — grids and self-checks
chunks.text: Inspection grid per zone scored 0 to 3. Weekly self-check by the team lead, monthly visit by the area manager, quarterly joint inspection with the client. Every deviation fixed within 24 working hours and logged in the tracking app.

chunks.title: Sheet — Product range and dosing
chunks.text: 86% of products used in 2025 carry the EU Ecolabel. Dilution stations for exact dosing, washable microfibre. Data sheets and safety data sheets kept up to date for each product.

chunks.title: Instructions — Waste sorting and bins
chunks.text: Bins emptied daily, waste sorted by stream (paper, packaging, general waste), colour-coded bags. Each site's rules are posted in the cleaning room.

chunks.title: Partnership — Employment inclusion
chunks.text: Partnership with the Tremplin Brumeux association (fictional): 7% of hours in 2025 performed by people on an inclusion pathway, mentored by an experienced cleaner.

chunks.title: Reference — Port-Brumeux library and nursery (2023–2026)
chunks.text: Client: Port-Brumeux town (fictional). Cleaning of a library and a 40-cot nursery, 2,900 hours a year, no penalties over 3 years. Contact: facilities department.

bullets.text: Work from 6:00 to 8:30 and after 18:00, never with the public present, as already in place at Brume-sur-Lys town hall.

Offices three times a week; washrooms and touch points daily, Monday to Friday (CCTP art. 4.2).
“Les Hirondelles” nursery: early-childhood protocol, fragrance- and allergen-free products, weekly steam disinfection of toys.
Windows twice a year: pure-water pole up to 12 m, lift above that through our usual subcontractor declared on a DC4.

Dilution stations and washable microfibre; safety data sheets attached for every product.
Waste sorted according to each site's rules, bins emptied daily.
